description: Buy one token package for this key's wallet. Only works if the key was issued with purchasing enabled, and only up to what the key may still spend — a purchase cannot lift the key's own spend cap. The answer says `charged` when the payment provider took it from the saved payment method, or `requires_human` with a `checkout_url` a person has to open. Either way the tokens arrive asynchronously: poll get_balance.
name: buy_tokens
title: Buy tokens for this key
